name: nulls_from_source_are_upstream_data
why: Separates `upstream_data` from `model_logic` where both would produce the same failing test. What settles it is that the nulls are already present at the source, in a column the model only passes through. Getting this wrong means rewriting a correct model to paper over a genuine ingestion defect — and the defect keeps landing.
